title: shelving/v1
description: nodes/<id>/shelving/<timestamp>-<contributor>.yaml (D-14 v3.47, D-32 v3.47; F31): a steward of the target or a listed curator shelves the statement (`scope: node`: it and every hole child beneath it) or retires one of its merged decompositions (`scope: route`, naming the partial's file: its holes and theirs), or lifts a shelving (`action: unshelved`), with a published cause. Always signed: by the network's approval key through the service for a signed-in login (`via: approval-key`), or by the signer's own key by hand (`via: ssh`). The gate refuses a record whose signer is neither a steward of the target nor a curator, one on the root, one on a statement a merged proof uses, and a route that is not the node's. Not a status: nothing it touches changes status; the products derive `shelved` on each row (graph/v15) from the node's own latest record, then inheritance. Earns nothing; ranks nothing (D-25 v3.47).

node.description: the node the record sits on

action.description: shelve (or retire, with scope route), or lift the node's standing shelving

scope.description: `node`: the statement and its hole children; `route`: one merged decomposition of the node, named in `route`, and its holes

route.description: the partial's file relative to the node, required when scope is route and null otherwise

cause.description: the published reasoning, always required; a person's words, shown demarcated (D-31)

contributor.description: the signer's GitHub login, as the service writes it

via.description: how the signature was made (D-3, D-32 v3.33): `ssh`, by the signer's own key; `approval-key`, by the network's approval key through the service for a login signed in on the site, in which case `key` must equal keys/approval.pub in the merge's parent tree

key.description: the key the signature verifies under

signature.description: an OpenSSH SSHSIG armored signature over the record's canonical body (opn_gate.signed), made with the private half of `key`
